description.fun: Roggenrola was discovered about a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. The hexagonal hole in its body isn't an eye but its ear, and it walks toward any sound it hears, panicking and toppling over if the sound stops. Deep inside is an energy core, so it's warm to the touch, and it gets very angry if you stick your hand in. Unova even has televised bowling with Roggenrola as the balls.
description.guide: Roggenrola is a Rock-type Pokémon formed deep underground, with a body as hard as steel. The hexagonal hole in its body is its ear, which leads to an energy core inside. It evolves into Boldore and then, when traded, Gigalith.
description.tagline: A rolling rock that listens through a hexagonal ear.

description.fun: Boldore's energy is too strong to stay inside, so it leaks out and hardens into orange crystals tough enough to smash diamonds. One fragment could fuel a hundred dump trucks, which is why people sometimes target it. It senses its surroundings by sound and always faces the same way, darting forward, back and sideways but never diagonally. It hunts for underground water, yet laps it up very carefully.
description.guide: Boldore is the evolved form of Roggenrola, a Rock-type Pokémon covered in orange crystals formed from its overflowing energy. It always faces the same direction and senses its surroundings by sound. It evolves into Gigalith when traded.
description.tagline: A crab-like rock leaking diamond-hard energy crystals.

description.fun: Gigalith soaks up sunlight in its orange crystals, magnifies it in its core and fires it from its mouth as an energy blast that can blow away a dump truck, though only while the sun is out. At full power, the blast could level a mountain and cracks its own body. Its horsepower makes it a popular partner on building sites and in mines, and in Galar it works alongside Copperajah.
description.guide: Gigalith is the final form of Roggenrola, a Rock-type Pokémon that absorbs sunlight with its crystals and fires it as powerful energy blasts. It is hardy and strong, and often works with people on construction sites and in mines.
description.tagline: A sun-powered rock cannon that works construction sites.
